inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Successful Sign in from Non-Compliant Device

properties.description: This rule will identify if there is any Successful Sign in from non-compliant devices
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Successful Sign in from Non-Compliant Device
properties.query:
union isfuzzy= true
    (SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where ResultType == 0       // Successful authentication
    | extend DeviceComplaint = tostring(DeviceDetail.isCompliant)
    | extend DeviceName = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName), DeviceOS = tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), DomainJoined = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
    | where isnotempty(DeviceComplaint)
    | where DeviceComplaint = false
    | project Category, ResultSignature,AppDisplayName, IPAddress, UserPrincipalName, DeviceName, DeviceOS, Location, AuthenticationRequirement, DomainJoined
    ),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where ResultType == 0       // Successful authentication
    | extend DeviceComplaint = tostring(parse_json(DeviceDetail).isCompliant)
    | extend DeviceName = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName), DeviceOS = tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem), Browser = tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), DomainJoined = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
    | where isnotempty(DeviceComplaint)
    | where DeviceComplaint = false
    | project Category, ResultType, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, UserPrincipalName, DeviceOS, Location, AuthenticationRequirement, DomainJoined
    )
